environment: production React + real AMap 2.0/tiles + isolated business/auth fixtures
findings: Two desktop project returns reproduced 54ms and 50ms tasks in AMap decodeStyleList/parseStyle XHR callbacks.
Sorted sampling intervals put 51.49ms/48.06ms in AMap stacks; no application frames in these task samples.
Main-thread minor GC was approximately 4.84ms/4.43ms, nested inside these task intervals; not additive.
This identifies a reproducible same-flow bottleneck; the historical 55ms task has no original CPU profile for exact retrospective attribution.

layerReuseExperiment.conclusion: No demonstrated reduction; retain existing engine/layer lifecycle and appearance.

limitations: Mobile is a desktop Chrome viewport, not an iOS/Android device.
No production authentication, database, business records or writes are exercised.
Frame intervals describe this machine/sample; CPU paint trace time is not GPU execution time.
Each route transition creates its own map; panel transitions must retain that route map.
CPU sample durations are estimates and profiler overhead is present.
Full sanitized captures are local artifacts; raw unsanitized CDP payloads were never written.
Original first capture summaries were reprocessed from saved profiles using sorted timestamps and forward intervals.
